name: Audit Trail Paragraph ancestry
description: Context contributor that walks a Paragraph entity's parent chain at audit time, recording the top-level host entity and the parent_type/parent_field path so a paragraph mutation is traceable to its host even after deletion.
project_description: Submodule of audit_trail. Adds the audit_trail_entity_paragraphs_ancestry context contributor: for a Paragraph subject it walks parent_type/parent_id/parent_field_name pointers iteratively to the first non-Paragraph ancestor (the real host entity) or a configurable depth cap (default 32, cycle-guarded), and emits into context_permanent the namespaced root resource (e.g. entity:node/4711) and the ordered intermediate parent path. This lets an investigator answer 'what changed on the contract document at node 4711' rather than 'what changed on paragraph 92831', even after the paragraph is deleted. Requires the audit_trail_entity bridge and the contrib paragraphs module.
